frames.text: It's 9:40 p.m. Sam has been waiting for this all day. One episode. That's the whole plan.
He sits down on the couch. He picks up the remote.
And from the kitchen, a dirty mug starts to feel like an emergency.
Then the unread message. Then the package by the front door.
If you've ever felt guilty for doing absolutely nothing, this one's for you.
By the end, you'll know why it happens, and what to do about it tonight.
